evals.name: adv-window
evals.prompt: I'm working a job and want to move to owning a system using Myron Golden's Window of Opportunity. Map my path from H.A.J. to O.A.S. starting with $0 and a Facebook Marketplace account.
assertions: Names the four window panes: Have A Job, Own A Job, Sow Money Seeds, Own A System
Places the user's starting point correctly and maps the steps
Uses the financial house (income, outgo, wealth reducing liabilities, income producing assets)

evals.name: adv-cans
evals.prompt: I'll make $500 this month from side sales. Split it using Golden's six money cans and explain each can.
assertions: Lists six cans: tithe, finish free, educate, save, have fun, pay bills
Uses the percentages (10/10/10/10/10/50 or as stated)
Applies them to $500 with dollar amounts
Mentions a mental trap or 'you are in the marketing business'
